children: Colombia increased the issuance of domestic debt securities by 25 trillion pesos ($8.00 billion) to finance its 2026 budget, according to a decree published on Thursday.
The increase is on top of the 85.25 trillion pesos initially approved to finance the national budget, according to the decree signed by Finance Minister Miguel Gomez.
Including this latest increase, the amount of domestic debt issued through local TES bonds in 2026 has risen to $35.57 billion.
TES bonds are the second-largest source of domestic financing for public spending in Colombia, just behind tax revenue.
